title: Passkeys
lead: Use your device's screen lock, a phone or a security key instead of typing a code at the second sign-in step. Your password is still asked first.
other_site: made for another site address, cannot be used here
unavailable: Passkeys need the site to run on https (GORUN_BASE_URL). Ask the operator to set it.
unsupported: This browser cannot use passkeys. Use a current browser, or the code from your authenticator app.
name: Passkey name
name_help: So you can tell your passkeys apart. Up to 64 characters.
confirm: Confirm your password to add a passkey
working: Follow the steps on your device…
cancelled: The passkey prompt was cancelled or timed out. Try again.
codes.lead: New recovery codes for your account. If you lose your passkeys, each of these codes signs you in once. Store them in a password manager or print them.
regen.lead: Enter one of your recovery codes to create a new set of ten. The old codes stop working.
remove.label: Remove passkey %s
remove.lead: Enter your password to remove this passkey. It will no longer sign you in.
remove.required: Your role requires two-factor authentication: add another passkey or the authenticator app before removing the last one.
error.invalid: The passkey could not be verified. Try again, or use a code.
error.unavailable: Passkeys are not available on this site address.
error.origin: This request did not come from this site's address.
error.expired: This passkey request expired or was already used. Try again.
error.name: Use up to 64 characters without line breaks.
error.none: You have no passkey for this site address. Use a code instead.
error.sign_count: This passkey reported a usage counter that went backwards, which can mean it was copied. Sign-in was refused; use a code and check the passkey.
login.lead: Use your passkey, or enter one of your recovery codes.
login.or_code: Or enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
login.or_recovery: Lost your passkey? Enter a recovery code.
login.recovery_help: A recovery code looks like xxxxx-xxxxx and works once.
